documents.name: Tax Staff

documents.description: Everything Tax Staff can do, plus full visibility, reassignment and cancel/withdraw.

documents.description: View routing records (scope decides whether that is only your own or everyone's).

documents.description: Advance a routing record through the workflow.

documents.name: Cancel / withdraw a routing record
documents.description: Permanently close a record (business spec 9.1). Checked in the cancel_record custom method, not by row filter.

documents.name: Reassign a routing record
documents.description: Change which user a record is assigned to. Checked in the reassign_record custom method.

documents.name: Bulk-select and resolve records
documents.description: Deferred capability (design doc section 3); reserved so the frontend can gate it once built.

documents.name: See the Assigned To column
documents.description: Frontend-only capability; the Assigned To column is shown when this is granted.

documents.name: Add a document
documents.description: Attach a document to a routing record.

documents.name: Read documents
documents.description: View the documents on a routing record.

documents.name: Update documents
documents.description: Change document metadata before it is filed.

documents.name: Remove a document
documents.description: Remove a document from a routing record before it is filed.

documents.name: View exception queue
documents.description: See every exception, regardless of who it is assigned to.

documents.name: Open an exception
documents.description: Opened by the routing workflow on the caller's behalf.

documents.name: Work / resolve an exception
documents.description: Retry or resolve an exception assigned to you.

documents.name: Read the document routing table
documents.description: Look up which folder a document type routes to.

documents.name: Read the taxpayer registry
documents.description: Staff see active taxpayers only; Tax Admin sees all (scope decides which).

documents.name: Read the entity list
documents.description: Staff see active entities only; Tax Admin sees all (scope decides which).

documents.name: Manage users, roles and permissions
documents.description: Create/deactivate users, grant or revoke roles, edit the permission matrix.
